Atomic Update and CompareExchange lower in frontend/lowerer/atomics.rs. Native path: add|sub|and|or|xor(old, x) (commuted for add/and/or/xor), not(and(old, x)), and old-free computations become fetch_add/sub/and/or/xor/nand/swap with x bound once; result=new recombines (wrapping_* for add/sub). CAS: compare_exchange[_weak]; write_back assigns *expected only on failure, success = is_ok(), old = either value. f32/f64 atomics (access, update, CAS) via AtomicU32/U64 bits. Barriers kept: dynamic order/weakness, non-system scope, volatile updates, fn-pointer and 128-bit updates, impure loop computations.
